body.message: REA_WABT_BIN_DIRECTORY must be an absolute tool directory.

remediation.action: Set absolute REA_WABT_BIN_DIRECTORY to a directory that contains wasm-validate, wasm-objdump and wasm2wat from WABT 1.0.42; each --version must report 1.0.42 on stdout with empty stderr. Correct the reported tool path, access or release before retrying, not the WASM input. Set this in the shell for the next CLI call, or in the MCP server launch environment and restart that server; a shell export does not update a running MCP server. Do not repeat the unchanged call or install tools implicitly.

details.reason: REA_WABT_BIN_DIRECTORY must be an absolute tool directory.
